Pick the goods

The outbound line reads Staged, and a shipment line exists.

Task 5 of 7 in Ship from stock · next: Ship

Walk it

Before you start

  • You need step 4.10 (Generate outbound advice).

Steps

Screen
Warehousing➔Outbound/Inspections➔Picking List (whinh4525m100)

Why LN works this way. The picking list records stock moving to staging, and confirming it fills Picked. You need this task where the warehouse is location-controlled and its outbound procedure's Picking List activity is manual; otherwise LN fills Picked on release. Once a line is staged, LN creates the shipment line.

StepActionYou should see
5.1Read Run in the headerThe Run from step 4.10 (Generate outbound advice)
5.2If it is your Run, go on to step 5.4. If it is another Run, click FindPicking List - Search opens
5.3Type your Run in Run and click OKYour Run in the header
5.4Confirm Warehouse and MissionMission is the Mission from step 4.10 (Generate outbound advice)
5.5Read the grid linesOne line per location the stock comes from: Picked · Sequence · Item · Serial Number · From Location. Picked shows a grey dot
5.6Pick the goods on each line from its From Location to its To Location
5.7Tick the lines you picked
5.8Actions➔Pick RunPicked shows a green tick. On the Warehousing Order, the line status becomes Staged
5.9Go back to the Warehousing Order tabThe order from Generate outbound advice
5.10Open the Shipment Lines tabA shipment line now exists. The shipment number is the first part of Shipment Line, before the line's own number:Write downshipment number

If something goes wrong

SymptomWhat to do
No Picking node under WarehousingThere isn't one. Picking is under Outbound/Inspections
Released Quantity is filled but Picked Quantity is emptyThat's expected. They are separate columns, and this task fills Picked
Run empty on the Picking ListAdvice may not have been generated, so nothing was released. Go back to step 4.6 (Generate outbound advice)

Variations

Variations
CaseWhat changes
Pick Mission / Pick Advice

Use these to pick one mission or one advice line instead of the whole run. See step 8
